Original accepted description (verbatim):
## Problem
The interrupted local rollout has structural health evidence but lacks a current complete
inventory, backup comparison, per-wing retrieval acceptance, and one fresh run proving initial
mine completion and watcher readiness. The evidence belongs to a different host, so all live
checks must run on that original rollout host.

## Blocker
Waits on owner access to the original rollout host. The stale-sweep provenance guard
(`MINE-STALE-SWEEP-PROVENANCE-GUARD`) and exact-line source roundtrip
(`MINE-SOURCE-EXACT-LINE-ROUNDTRIP`) landed on 2026-09-08.

## Scope
Reconcile current state read-only first, then perform only explicitly authorized local rollout
actions after a release containing the stale-sweep guard is installed and verified on that
host. Reuse native watch, health, backup, storage inventory, and search surfaces. Do not
perform an automatic global rebuild, archive purge, credential rotation, watcher redesign,
sibling-repository commits, or expand Git event support from unproven limitations.

## Reuse ledger
capability | existing owner | completion evidence | residual delta | action
rollout acceptance | native watch status/events, health, backup, inventory, and scoped search | prior stopped-state and structural-health evidence | fresh inventory, preservation comparison, completed run, and retrieval evidence | reuse

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checks on the original rollout host identify the actual palace, installed runtime, writer owners, watcher state, disk gate, and available rollback artifacts without relying on stale paths or PIDs.
- [ ] Manual and diary inventory is compared with the pre-rollout backup without exposing stored content.
- [ ] Freshness, current source hashes, pending exclusions, and representative per-wing retrieval are measured for the authorized repository set.
- [ ] Exact-line acceptance uses the landed MINE-SOURCE-EXACT-LINE-ROUNDTRIP behavior; rename acceptance waits for WING-MIGRATION-FULL-COPY-QUALIFICATION.
- [ ] With the landed MINE-STALE-SWEEP-PROVENANCE-GUARD installed on the rollout host and separate resume authority, one verified writer run emits initial-mine-started, initial-mine-completed, an explained optimize outcome, and watch-ready for one run ID.
- [ ] Commit-event integration and unsupported Git layouts are reported by observed evidence; no user commits or branches are created solely for a canary without authority.
- [ ] Final health, exclusions, ownership, and retrieval checks pass, or the exact blocker and one recovery command are recorded.

exclusions: Do not perform an automatic global rebuild, archive purge, credential rotation, watcher redesign, sibling-repository commits, or expand Git event support from unproven limitations.
No user commits or branches solely for a canary without authority.

completion.result: Bounded original-host rollout reconciliation and native watcher acceptance verified. The installed guard and source-exact runtime were exercised; a missing declared watch dependency was repaired without changing other distributions. One successful writer run completed initial indexing, optimization and watcher readiness. Final health, manual/diary preservation, exact-line roundtrip, source freshness and all-wing retrieval passed within the measured exclusions. Git observation limits were recorded; no synthetic commit was created. Rename acceptance remains conditional on the separate full-copy recovery-evidence task.

Original accepted description (verbatim):
## Problem
The interrupted local rollout has structural health evidence but lacks a current complete
inventory, backup comparison, per-wing retrieval acceptance, and one fresh run proving initial
mine completion and watcher readiness. The evidence belongs to a different host, so all live
checks must run on that original rollout host.

## Blocker
Waits on owner access to the original rollout host. The stale-sweep provenance guard
(`MINE-STALE-SWEEP-PROVENANCE-GUARD`) and exact-line source roundtrip
(`MINE-SOURCE-EXACT-LINE-ROUNDTRIP`) landed on 2026-09-08.

## Scope
Reconcile current state read-only first, then perform only explicitly authorized local rollout
actions after a release containing the stale-sweep guard is installed and verified on that
host. Reuse native watch, health, backup, storage inventory, and search surfaces. Do not
perform an automatic global rebuild, archive purge, credential rotation, watcher redesign,
sibling-repository commits, or expand Git event support from unproven limitations.

## Reuse ledger
capability | existing owner | completion evidence | residual delta | action
rollout acceptance | native watch status/events, health, backup, inventory, and scoped search | prior stopped-state and structural-health evidence | fresh inventory, preservation comparison, completed run, and retrieval evidence | reuse

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checks on the original rollout host identify the actual palace, installed runtime, writer owners, watcher state, disk gate, and available rollback artifacts without relying on stale paths or PIDs.
- [ ] Manual and diary inventory is compared with the pre-rollout backup without exposing stored content.
- [ ] Freshness, current source hashes, pending exclusions, and representative per-wing retrieval are measured for the authorized repository set.
- [ ] Exact-line acceptance uses the landed MINE-SOURCE-EXACT-LINE-ROUNDTRIP behavior; rename acceptance waits for WING-MIGRATION-FULL-COPY-QUALIFICATION.
- [ ] With the landed MINE-STALE-SWEEP-PROVENANCE-GUARD installed on the rollout host and separate resume authority, one verified writer run emits initial-mine-started, initial-mine-completed, an explained optimize outcome, and watch-ready for one run ID.
- [ ] Commit-event integration and unsupported Git layouts are reported by observed evidence; no user commits or branches are created solely for a canary without authority.
- [ ] Final health, exclusions, ownership, and retrieval checks pass, or the exact blocker and one recovery command are recorded.

exclusions: Do not perform an automatic global rebuild, archive purge, credential rotation, watcher redesign, sibling-repository commits, or expand Git event support from unproven limitations.
No user commits or branches solely for a canary without authority.
